summary: The branches and calls match, but field mapping and load order do not meet the verification standard.
issues: Offsets 0x44, 0x4c, 0x54, and 0x184 are used as raw addresses instead of named struct members.
The binary loads the 0x4c field before the 0x184 field. C++ does not guarantee that order when evaluating the two call arguments.
fix_instructions: Define named members for all four fields and verify their offsets with static_assert(offsetof(...)).
Read the 0x4c field into a temporary, then read the 0x184 field into a temporary, then call FUN_006b2408 with the 0x184 value and the low byte of the 0x4c value.
